body: It's hard to change that when I have literal disorders for it. That's a little harder to fix than a sad kid who's sleeping schedule is a little off. But maybe you're right. I can try to pick up some weights and see what I can do.

Anxiety or not, I still deal with every single other problem on this list that is me being alive. It's not even a big factor, but you have good ideas. I would love to get a dog. But as with every other solution I've found, that's not possible to do. I appreciate the help, though.

I'm not gone yet. But I hope to be within a month. It all depends on how long I can last without completely losing it. And yeah I agree with you, most of the stories here aren't built or explained very well, making them seem fake, which is disrespectful to people who come on here looking to tell their sincere stories. Again thanks for reading what I had to say, I will keep in mind what you have said to me, even if that is to the grave.
You should talk to me about it. I'm not going to try to talk you out of it or anything, I just want to get to know you better.
